text.text_excerpt: We just wanted to tell you how much we enjoyed our stay at your establishment. We've traveled a lot over the years, and I don't think we've ever been treated with such courtesy and friendship from check in to check out as we have with you. We just love this place! For those who want to feel that they are part of a bygone era (with all of the plush modern conveniences) this is the place for you! From relaxing in the courtyard to the beautifully appointed rooms, this is an absolutely lovely experience. Thanks again for making our trip, once again, completely perfect!
If you can afford it, this is the greatest and most charming hotel in the city. And their BISCUITS, good Lord. The courtyard is like something out of a fairy tale, too.

When I want to go to NOLA there is only one Hotel I want to stay. My husband knows exactly who to call first for reservations & if they are booked up & we can't get any reservations we usually just cancel going. I have stayed many other places in NOLA. I grew up in the area. I know the city well. The city of my childhood. There is no other place in the world like New Orleans & there is no where else I would rather stay when I visit, than the Soniat House. It's always my first choice. I love several rooms for different reasons. They are all completely different so staying in a few different rooms is the way to go. The junior suites are perfect for longer stays & the room across the street ...
